extra_quotes: Multislice electron ptychographic reconstructions were performed using the least-squares maximum-likelihood multislice algorithm [20,26,27] implemented in the GPU_MS engine of the fold_slice package [28], which builds upon PtychoShelves [29].

Bayesian optimization (BO) was used to jointly determine three parameters required for multislice electron ptychography: the total specimen thickness t, the probe defocus Δf, and the number of slices N, with the slice spacing d efined as Δz = t/N.
A practical limitation is that the optimization still requires physically reasonable search bounds.
